body.p: If you have attained your want and changed from your earlier commitment concerning my need,

p.n: The Cat States the Rat's Duty of Reciprocation

body.p:
You found in my previous amity gain and benefit,
as you have seen: you owe me reward accordingly and

are not to remember the enmity between you and me,
for what has transpired between us erases any previous grudge and turns each one away from what nested
in his companion’s heart.

p.n: The Punishment of Betrayal Comes Swiftly

body.p:
